en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard image depicting a plaza with a monument at its center, surrounded by well-kept gardens, buildings, and mountains in the background. The prominent text in red identifies the location as Piazza Dante, with references to Hotel Trento and the railway station, indicating a central and notable urban area. There is handwriting at the bottom in Italian and a line of small text about reproduction rights.
